meta.title: Business onboarding - Quick Come
meta.description: Complete your Quick Come business onboarding (KYB).

intro.title: Business onboarding
intro.body: Please complete all steps and upload the supporting documents. You can save at any time and continue later using the same link.

s1.title: 1. Entity information
s1.legalFormHint: As shown on the certificate of incorporation or registration, e.g. IBC, Ltd.

natureOptions.fx: Foreign exchange and financial market trading

s1.purpose: Purpose of the business relationship with Quick Come
s1.currencies: Currencies / digital assets expected to be used
s1.sanctions: Does the company expect any direct or indirect transactions involving sanctioned countries/territories or sanctioned persons?
s1.sanctionsDetails: Please provide the relevant jurisdictions, nature of activity and expected transaction volume.
s1.parent: Group / parent company name, if any

s4.title: 4. Directors, UBOs and authorized signatories
s4.body: Add every director, ultimate beneficial owner (25% or more ownership or control) and authorized signatory. If one person holds several roles, add them once and tick all roles. At least one director and one UBO are required.
s4.pctHint: UBOs only. Enter 0–100. If ownership and voting rights are the same, enter the same number.
s4.pep: Is this person a Politically Exposed Person (PEP), or a family member or close associate of a PEP?
s4.pepDetails: Please provide the official title/position and public function, or the nature of the relationship together with the PEP's full name and title.

s5.title: 5. Supporting documents
s5.body: Documents must be current, valid and legible. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each. You can upload several files for one item.
s5.poa: Proof of address (within the last 3 months)

docs.d2: Certificate of Incumbency / Good Standing / Commercial Registry extract (issued within the last 90 days)
docs.d5: Company proof of address (within the last 3 months)
docs.d10: Regulatory status verification / Financial license / Legal opinion
docs.d11: Source of initial funding / capital supporting evidence
docs.d12: Source of Funds (SOF) & Source of Wealth (SOW) supporting evidence

s5.note: Additional documents may be requested after our initial review.

s6.title: 6. Virtual asset wallet authorization
s6.body: This declaration is required before we can process deposits into, or withdrawals to, your virtual asset wallet.
s6.idHint: Use the same identification provided in this application.
ownership: I am the sole owner of, and have full and exclusive control over, the private keys of the wallet above.
I have not authorised any other person to access or control this wallet on my behalf.
I authorise Quick Come to process deposits and/or withdrawals to and from this wallet for the purpose(s) indicated above.
The information in this form is true, accurate and complete, and I will promptly notify Quick Come of any change.
I understand that false or misleading information may result in rejection, delay or refusal, and may be reported to the relevant authorities as required by law.
s6.ownershipCheck: I confirm the declaration of ownership above.
risk: Virtual asset transactions are recorded on public blockchains and, once submitted, cannot be reversed, cancelled or recovered by Quick Come, including transactions sent to an incorrect address.
I am responsible for the accuracy of the wallet information and for safeguarding the private keys and credentials of the wallet.

Where a loss results from inaccurate wallet information or my failure to safeguard access, I agree to bear that loss and to indemnify Quick Come, except to the extent caused by Quick Come's own negligence, wilful misconduct or breach of applicable law.
Deposits and withdrawals are subject to Quick Come's identity verification and AML checks, and may be delayed, declined or reported as required by law.

proofOptions.provider: Screenshot from the wallet provider or exchange showing the address linked to an account in the entity's name
proofOptions.explorer: Blockchain explorer screenshot plus proof of control (signed message or reference code provided by us)

s7.title: 7. Declaration and signature
s7.declaration: I/We confirm that the information and documents provided are complete and accurate to the best of my/our knowledge. I/We undertake to notify Quick Come of any material changes to the information provided.
s7.signHint: Sign inside the box using your mouse, finger or stylus.
s7.recorded: The date, time and IP address of signing will be recorded.

done.title: Application submitted
done.body: Thank you. We have received your application and will review it shortly. We will contact you by email if anything else is needed.
done.readonly: This application can no longer be edited.

errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.future: The passport must not be expired.
errors.people: Add at least one director and one UBO.
errors.fileType: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files are accepted.
errors.fileSize: Each file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please contact us for a new link.
errors.percent: Enter a number from 0 to 100 (up to 2 decimal places).

en.locked: This section does not need changes. Only the sections requested by our team can be edited.

meta.title: 企业开户 - Quick Come
meta.description: 完成 Quick Come 企业开户资料（KYB）。

intro.title: 企业开户
intro.body: 请完成全部步骤并上传证明文件。您可以随时保存，之后用同一个链接继续填写。

s1.title: 1. 企业信息
s1.legalForm: 法律形式 / 企业类型
s1.legalFormHint: 按注册证书上的写法填写，例如 IBC、Ltd。
s1.lei: 法人机构识别编码（LEI），如有
s1.purpose: 与 Quick Come 建立业务关系的用途

purposeOptions.crypto: 接受客户的加密货币付款

s1.currencies: 预计使用的币种和数字资产
s1.sanctions: 公司是否预计会有直接或间接涉及受制裁国家、地区或受制裁人员的交易？
s1.sanctionsDetails: 请说明涉及的国家或地区、业务性质和预计交易量。
s1.parent: 集团 / 母公司名称，如有

s2.title: 2. 公司联系方式
s2.otherContact: 其他联系方式（例如 Telegram、Teams）

s3.title: 3. 授权联系人
s3.name: 姓名
s3.otherContact: 其他联系方式（例如 Telegram、Teams）

s4.title: 4. 董事、最终受益人（UBO）和授权签字人
s4.body: 请添加每一位董事、最终受益人（直接或间接持股或控制 25% 及以上）和授权签字人。同一个人有多个角色时，只需添加一次并勾选全部角色。至少需要 1 名董事和 1 名 UBO。
s4.pctHint: 仅 UBO 填写，0 到 100。持股比例和投票权比例相同时，填写相同的数字。
s4.pep: 此人是否为政治公众人物（PEP），或 PEP 的家庭成员、密切关系人？
s4.pepDetails: 请填写官方职务及公共职能；如果是家庭成员或密切关系人，请说明与 PEP 的关系，以及 PEP 本人的全名和职务。

s5.title: 5. 证明文件
s5.body: 文件须为最新、有效、清晰的版本。格式为 PDF、JPG 或 PNG，每个文件不超过 10MB。同一项可以上传多个文件。

docs.d1: 公司注册证书 / 设立文件
docs.d2: 董事在职证明 / 存续证明 / 商业登记摘录（90 天内签发）
docs.d4: 股东名册 / 股权结构表
docs.d5: 公司地址证明（3 个月内）
docs.d10: 监管身份证明 / 金融牌照 / 法律意见书
docs.d12: 资金来源（SOF）和财富来源（SOW）证明
docs.d13: 董事会决议 / 授权委托书
docs.d15: 近 1 到 2 年的财务报表
docs.d16: 反洗钱 / 反恐融资政策摘要

s5.note: 初步审核后，我们可能会要求补充其他文件。

s6.title: 6. 数字资产钱包授权
s6.body: 在我们为您的数字资产钱包处理充值或提现之前，需要您完成这份声明。
s6.idHint: 请与本申请中提供的证件保持一致。
ownership: 本人是上述钱包私钥的唯一所有者，拥有完全且排他的控制权。
本人未授权任何其他人代表本人访问或控制该钱包。
本人授权 Quick Come 按上述用途，处理该钱包的充值和/或提现。
本表所填信息真实、准确、完整；如有变化，本人会及时通知 Quick Come。
本人理解，提供虚假或误导性信息可能导致申请被拒绝、交易被延迟或拒绝，并可能依法上报相关机构。
s6.ownershipCheck: 我确认以上所有权声明。
risk: 数字资产交易记录在公共区块链上，一经提交，Quick Come 无法撤销、取消或追回，包括转到错误地址的交易。
本人对所提供钱包信息的准确性负责，并负责保管该钱包的私钥和凭证。
因钱包信息不准确或本人未妥善保管导致的损失，由本人承担，并赔偿 Quick Come 因此遭受的损失；但因 Quick Come 自身过失、故意不当行为或违反法律造成的除外。
该钱包的充值和提现须经过 Quick Come 的身份核验和反洗钱审查，可能会被延迟、拒绝或依法上报。

proofOptions.provider: 钱包服务商或交易所截图，显示该地址关联在本企业名下的账户
proofOptions.explorer: 区块浏览器截图，并附控制权证明（签名消息或我们提供的参考码）

s7.title: 7. 声明与签名
s7.declaration: 本人/我们确认所提供的信息和文件，就本人/我们所知是完整和准确的；如所提供的信息发生重大变化，本人/我们将通知 Quick Come。
s7.signHint: 请用鼠标、手指或触控笔在框内签名。
s7.recorded: 系统会记录签署的日期、时间和 IP 地址。

done.title: 申请已提交
done.body: 感谢您的提交。我们已收到您的申请，会尽快审核；如需补充资料，我们会通过邮件联系您。

errors.email: 请输入有效的邮箱地址。
errors.phone: 只能包含数字、空格、+、- 或括号。
errors.people: 至少需要 1 名董事和 1 名 UBO。
errors.fileType: 只接受 PDF、JPG 或 PNG 格式。
errors.invalid: 此链接无效或已过期，请联系我们获取新的链接。
errors.percent: 请输入 0 到 100 的数字，最多 2 位小数。

zh.locked: 这一部分无需修改。只能修改我们要求补充的部分。
